title: Domain-Driven Design
author: Eric Evans
when_to_use: Strategic & Tactical modeling. Solves database/controller leakage into business rules.
review_checklist: Create Ubiquitous Language, boundary contexts, guard aggregates.

title: Implementing Domain-Driven Design
author: Vaughn Vernon
when_to_use: Real-world tactical patterns: Aggregates, Domain Events, and Application Services.

title: Domain-Driven Design Distilled
author: Vaughn Vernon
when_to_use: Lightweight, high-impact tactical patterns with minimal ceremony.

title: Clean Architecture
author: Robert C. Martin
when_to_use: Stable boundaries, the dependency rule, and keeping frameworks decoupled from business policies.
review_checklist: Isolate frameworks, strictly enforce the dependency rule, decouple logic from DB.

title: Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture
author: Martin Fowler
when_to_use: Enforcing clear data access, application-logic, and presentation layers.

title: A Philosophy of Software Design
author: John Ousterhout
when_to_use: Deep modules, simple interfaces, low cognitive load, and strategic vs. tactical design.
review_checklist: Fight shallow classes, maximize information hiding, minimize cognitive load.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
when_to_use: Readability, meaningful naming conventions, tiny functions, and clean exception handling.
review_checklist: Descriptive naming, single-responsibility functions, readable error handling.

title: Code Complete
author: Steve McConnell
when_to_use: General software construction: variables, loops, control flow, and disciplined design decision-making.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: Andrew Hunt & David Thomas
when_to_use: DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), orthogonality, automation, fast feedback loops, and agility.

title: Refactoring
author: Martin Fowler
when_to_use: Systematic code transformations, identifying code smells, and taking precise micro-steps with tests.
review_checklist: Prevent "feature creep during cleanup", mandate step-by-step green-to-green refactoring.

title: Refactoring.Guru
when_to_use: Practical refactoring processes, Design Patterns mapping, and diagnostic treatment of smells.

title: Working Effectively with Legacy Code
author: Michael Feathers
when_to_use: Breaking dependencies, establishing seams, writing characterization tests, and mitigating change risks.
review_checklist: Establish integration characterization tests, locate seams, sprout/wrap safely.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
when_to_use: Reliability, schemas, partition/replication strategies, and consistency trade-offs.
review_checklist: Mitigate data corruption, design for eventual consistency, validate transactions.

title: Release It!
author: Michael T. Nygard
when_to_use: Resilience patterns: circuit breakers, bulkheads, timeouts, retries, and production observability.
